Name: No Crows
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]No Crows[/size]

This mod makes it so crows won't eat your crops. You no longer have to worry about making sure all of your crops are in range of a scarecrow or watch a crow eat your hard earned star fruit. Scarecrows won't do anything, but you can still place scarecrows for decoration if you want!

[size=5][b]** There is now only one version that works for linux/mac/windows, no need to download a separate one for each platform :) **[/b]

[b]This mod is compatible with the beta, just download it and install like normal.[/b][/size]

This mod requires[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases] SMAPI[/url] by PathosChild. To install the mod, place the NoCrows folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

If you get an error related to the mod not working, please submit a bug report :).

Also thanks to Eiri for the crossed out crow icon! (It's been slightly enlarged so it doesn't look as good as the original)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]
